summary: Implemented the Q-001-compliant authentication and session foundation: strict shared Admin-login/session/logout contracts; normalized Admin email/password login with Argon2id hashes isolated in a connection-scoped AdminCredential model; short-lived signed access tokens; 32-byte opaque refresh tokens stored only as SHA-256 hashes; compare-and-set refresh rotation; family revocation on concurrent or later reuse; expiry/account-state checks; current-session logout; no-store responses; and host-only HttpOnly SameSite=Strict refresh cookies that are Secure outside Local/Test. Added POST /api/v1/auth/login, /refresh, and /logout and synchronized runtime inventory, OpenAPI, Postman, product blueprint, environment validation, tests, and documentation. Seeker/Provider phone OTP remains exclusively backend_012 scope.
